tiers.name: Rapid Path
tiers.description: Simple file lookups, code/directory exploration, or a single minor edit to 1 file. Proceed immediately and report inline with a concise summary.
triggers: Single file minor edit (1 file only)

tiers.name: Test-Verified Sequential Path
tiers.description: Interrelated edits across 2 files, internal component refactoring, or new unit test additions. Proceed sequentially with mandatory independent automated verification (bun test, lint) after each edit before moving to the next file. Halt immediately and report root cause on any failure.

tiers.name: Adversarial HITL Gate
tiers.description: Three or more core files modified/created simultaneously; system architecture or database schema design/changes (*.prisma, *.sql, migrations); external API/network integration or auth/authorization structure changes; requirement branching or alternative selection. Must decompose into 3-5 independently verifiable phases. Activate the adversarial evaluation workflow (Researcher → Specialist → Auditor) and obtain explicit user approval (HITL Gate) before each phase.
triggers: 3 or more core files modified or created simultaneously
Database schema design or migration (*.prisma, *.sql, migrations)
External API/network integration or auth structure change
